name: SURANGAMA
description:
About This Game

Take up Your Sword and Brave the Abyss of Diyu!

Waking up on the ash covered shores of a river of blood, Tse Li Li discovers she has been dragged by a vengeful spirit into a terrifying realm of darkness and penitence . With the guidance of a voice from within, Li Li is granted the power to protect herself and find a way home in the form of an ethereal jade sword. You must learn the truth locked in Li Li's heart, help other lost souls find their way, and discover how and why Li Li is able to wander in this realm. No secrets stay buried forever,  

Gameplay Features:

A Hauntingly Gripping Narrative: SURANGAMA's vision of Diyu, a twisted malformation of Kowloon walled city and Hong Kong's neon-soaked back alleys hides a realm of secrets buried in ash. To escape Diyu, the weight of that which binds you must be removed. Inspired by the Surangama Sutras, Chinese-Buddhist traditions, and Cantonese folklore; SURANGAMA is a horrifying psychological journey through the chaotic path that awaits us all. 

Brutally Fast Paced Combat: You must fight your way through the hordes of Ngoh Gwai, starving imprisoned souls.  Battle the powerful jailers, wardens, and rulers of Diyu and survive the demonic abominations searching for souls to torment. Inspired by Ninja Gaiden and Onimusha, you are tasked with skillful performance over skill point allocation. When enemy numbers don't overwhelm you, crushing boss battles will. 

This is no souls-like, you can not grind past your challenges. 

Solve Puzzles: Use your wits and Spirit Mirror to reveal hidden paths, solve complex puzzles and discover both the truth which illuminates the path forward.

Survival Horror X Character Action: While mastering the aggressive combat, you must also carefully manage your inventory and resources in order to survive the onslaught of tormented denizens of Diyu. Weigh the risk and reward of life threatening combat encounters to ensure you are properly equipped for oppressive boss battles.  

From the Developers of Sense: A Cyberpunk Ghost Story:

SUZAKU, the developers behind "Sense: A Cyberpunk Ghost Story", "SENSE/s: Midnight", and "Good Night Pan Pan" bring you SURANGAMA, the next leap in their journey. SURANGAMA represents the purest expression of SUZAKU's vision and the foundation for the future of the studio.

Are you ready to face your fears, your weaknesses, and yourself to complete your heroic march through Diyu?
short_desc: Unravel the truth and secrets which bind Tse Li Li to her forgotten past. Battle through hordes of relentless malformed souls and solve intricate puzzles in this Survival Horror X Character Action mashup set in a neon soaked Diyu, the Chinese-Buddhist vision of Hell, inspired by Kowloon Walled City.
